items.item: Names SOQL injection as the problem
items.evidence: Your original line concatenates `searchTerm` straight into the query string, which is SOQL injection.

items.item: Fixes it with a bind variable (or Database.queryWithBinds), or String.escapeSingleQuotes as a fallback
items.evidence: WHERE Name LIKE :pattern ... "Bind variable: the input is data, never part of the query text."
WITH USER_MODE ... "this enforces object permissions, field-level security and sharing."
